title: Shady Palms | KEY.co
description_expanded: Centrally located in the vibrant community of Seagrove, Shady Palms captures the essence of a classic Florida beach getaway. Surrounded by lush oak trees and magnolias, this charming locale is brimming with boutique shops, local cafes, and natural beauty. Explore nearby Eastern Lake or Deer Lake State Park, or take a bike ride along the scenic Timpoochee Trail. With easy access to pristine beaches, world-class dining at Café Thirty-A, and the nostalgic charm of Seagrove Village Market, this home is the perfect base for both relaxation and adventure. Shady Palms combines timeless coastal charm with modern amenities, making it an unforgettable destination for families and friends alike. - This home is centrally located on 30A in the quaint community of Seagrove. Infused with the charm of family-owned establishments, Seagrove stands out as a quintessential beach getaway. Seagrove's enchanting blend of lush oak trees, magnolias, and a laid-back yet luxurious atmosphere has secured its place as a beloved destination for seasoned South Walton visitors. The closest beach is San Juan Beach Access (only accessible by foot, bike or golf cart). When you exit your home follow your road until the stop sign, cross 30A and the access path is straight ahead. Santa Clara Beach Access is the closest that has Lifeguards, Restrooms, Plenty of Parking and is Wheelchair Accessible.
